title: Raw error codes shown to users ('team_not_found', 'invalid_regex'); error toast is hidden behind the 'Index a codebase' FAB
repro_steps: Team > Join with ID + bogus code 'zzzz'; Search with Regex on and '(['
expected: Human-readable error messages, toast fully visible
actual: Inline text 'team_not_found' and 'invalid_regex'; red toast text cut off under the FAB ('…ot found', '…regex'). Empty Join is disabled with no hint
fix_note: Raw dx error tokens ('team_not_found', 'invalid_regex', 22 more) reached the user verbatim at every DxWorkbench error funnel and the DevToolingPulse throw. All funnels now pass through one translator (components/dx-platform/errorWords.ts) holding the domain's vocabulary read from server/domains/dx-platform.js and dx.js; an unseen snake_case token falls back to a worded server-failure sentence, never the raw token. Named: the ticket's hidden-toast leg — the error renders are in-flow paragraphs, not a toast layer, so the layering claim is not code-verifiable from this seat. Disclosure: the shipped SARIF-export test pinned the raw 'handler_error' text; its one assertion now expects the translated sentence. The fix was merged onto the dx-platform-017 head (0e5f59409) with that section's hunks preserved. Guard: tests/error-surfacing-genus.test.ts (CB-0485).

title: Raw error codes in Empirical tools ('expr_required', 'fromUnits_and_toUnits_required'); Claim Scanner shows nothing for junk

title: Invalid deep link ?id=bogus123 opens an entry modal showing the raw 'unknown_event' alert; also a 400 from /api/lens/run in the console
actual: Raw error code in the modal
fix_note: A deep link with a bogus id opened the entry modal showing the raw 'unknown_event' token (lore.get returns it in the reason field). The modal now reads error ?? reason and shows its own plain sentence, 'No entry matches this link.' Guard: tests/error-surfacing-genus.test.ts (CB-0485).

title: Decrypt picker: loading a non-.enc file shows no error and keeps the previous file name
fix_note: Loading a non-.enc file in the decrypt picker showed the rejection but left the previous archive loaded and named ('Loaded: <old file>'), so the panel contradicted itself and the old envelope stayed decryptable. Both failure paths now clear the envelope and file name — after a rejection, nothing is loaded. Guard: tests/error-surfacing-genus.test.ts (CB-0485).

title: Create project and Validate hang disabled forever on API failure (no error, no retry)
repro_steps: With API 502: App name > SaaS > Create project; or Validate
actual: Spinner forever; Validate disabled after one 502
fix_note: Split scope. SILENT-FAILURE LEG fixed: ForgeWorkbench's Validate and Generate mutations fetch directly and their error state was never read — a failed call settled silently (spinner stopped, nothing appeared). Both failures now render a worded, retryable line under the header. CREATE-HANG LEG named, not discharged as reproduced: at branch state ForgeStudio's create path awaits lensRun, which catches internally and always resolves, so the creating flag always settles and the error speaks; the hang does not reproduce from code. Guard: tests/error-surfacing-genus.test.ts (CB-0485).
